Operations

Service status

This page tracks the external services YoYo Map depends on. Where a provider offers an official status API, we show a live rollup. Everywhere else, we link directly to the vendor's status page or reference surface.

Core app

Vercel

All Systems Operational

Hosts the Next.js site, API routes, cron jobs, and runtime infrastructure.

What would be interrupted: If Vercel is down, the site, submit flow, admin routes, and scheduled jobs can all fail or become unavailable.
Vercel status

Last vendor update: Apr 28, 2026, 10:33 AM UTC

Core app

Supabase

All Systems Operational

Backs the database, auth-adjacent token storage, location data, reports, reminders, and audit logs.

What would be interrupted: If Supabase is degraded, map data, submissions, profile management, moderation, and location lookups may fail or return stale data.
Supabase status

Last vendor update: Apr 28, 2026, 10:34 AM UTC

Delivery

Resend

Linked status page

Delivers verification emails, consent links, magic links, reminders, and admin notices.

What would be interrupted: If Resend is down, entries can still be saved in some flows, but verification, consent, and recovery emails may be delayed or blocked.

Official status page only. We are not fetching a machine-readable status feed for this service.

Resend status

Infrastructure

Porkbun

Linked status page

Handles domain registration and parts of the site DNS management chain.

What would be interrupted: If Porkbun has DNS or domain control issues, the site or email-related endpoints may become hard to resolve or manage.

Best treated as a linked status source here. Their public status surface is not wired into this page as a live API feed.

Porkbun status

Infrastructure

Cloudflare

Minor Service Outage

Porkbun notes Cloudflare-backed DNS infrastructure in their status reporting.

What would be interrupted: If Cloudflare DNS is degraded, domain resolution can break even when the app itself is healthy.
Cloudflare status

Last vendor update: Apr 28, 2026, 3:20 PM UTC

Infrastructure

GitHub

Partially Degraded Service

Hosts the source repository and CI/CD visibility around the project.

What would be interrupted: If GitHub is down, the live site may continue to serve, but repo access, workflow runs, and some deployment visibility can be interrupted.
GitHub status

Last vendor update: Apr 28, 2026, 3:20 PM UTC

Mapping

OpenStreetMap Nominatim

Linked status page

Used server-side for geocoding city and address inputs during submissions and admin re-geocoding.

What would be interrupted: If Nominatim is unavailable, new submissions, shop address validation, and bulk re-geocoding can fail even if the public map still loads.

This page links to the official Nominatim status documentation rather than polling it directly.

Nominatim status docs

Mapping

OpenStreetMap platform

Linked status page

Upstream map and search ecosystem used by parts of the map and geocoding workflow.

What would be interrupted: Broader OpenStreetMap issues can affect map-related features, especially geocoding and upstream data availability.
OpenStreetMap platform status

Mapping

CARTO basemaps

Linked status page

Provides the tile basemap layer rendered under the YoYo Map markers.

What would be interrupted: If CARTO tiles fail, the map background can appear blank or incomplete while entry data and API routes still work.
CARTO status

Signals

Downdetector

Linked status page

Community-reported outage chatter across consumer and infrastructure services.

What would be interrupted: This does not directly power YoYo Map, but it can help confirm wider regional or ISP issues when official pages are quiet.

Community signal only, not an official vendor status source.

Downdetector

A green badge here means the vendor reports normal operation, not that every YoYo Map feature is guaranteed healthy. If the site feels broken while a provider shows green, check recent incidents, cached deploy issues, and browser console/network failures too.
